Like a beaten bull in the ring seeking a way to escape and gazing up at the amphitheatre of pitiless faces, so the Jefe looked up and saw only the rifles of the sackcloth men, the triumphing faces of Leoncia and Francis, the curious looks of his own gendarmes, and the blood-eager faces of the haciendados that were like the faces of any bull-fight audience.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u013-r0033", "tag": "p", "text": "The shadowy smile drifted the stern lips of the leader as he handed the rifle to Henry and started to blindfold him.", "sha256": "84319ec6adc454a480c8f14358afc1da4470b462290f12befae8f92fd229e767", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1057]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u013-r0034", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why don’t you make him face the wall until I’m ready?” the Jefe demanded, as the silver bell tinkled in his passion-convulsed hand.", "sha256": "b75f27a2a343ebd66c6328eeaf936002a79195bfec641a8a502c60efc103e420", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1058]", "source_html": "

“Why don’t you make him face the wall until I’m ready?” the Jefe demanded, as the silver bell tinkled in his passion-convulsed hand.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u013-r0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“Because he is proven God’s man,” was the reply. “He has stood the test. Therefore he cannot do a treacherous deed. You now must stand the test of God. If you are true and honest, no harm can befall you from the Snake. For such is God’s way.”", "sha256": "524965b16911479756c0fcdbef1bda427714fefe347d09ee94ca7166f8092e69", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1059]", "source_html": "

Across the pit from Henry, he strove to stand motionless; but out of nervousness, as Henry’s rifle swept around on him, his hand trembled and the bell tinkled. The rifle came almost to rest and wavered ominously about the sound. In vain the Jefe tried to control his flesh and still the bell.", "sha256": "4b1e0352fd938db70e56c3066d64f5cbe641db45ec430ee80baaad964a3e7399", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1060]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u013-r0037", "tag": "p", "text": "But the bell tinkled on, and, in despair, he flung it away and threw himself on the ground. But Henry, following the sound of his enemy’s fall, lowered the rifle and pulled trigger. The Jefe yelled out in sharp pain as the bullet perforated his shoulder, rose to his feet, cursed, sprawled back on the ground, and lay there cursing.", "sha256": "9f8dad694b5fc1f3d27093353b9fe00e92c7b5088ab4cde7ba0ff6d0d10c8997", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1061]", "source_html": "

But the bell tinkled on, and, in despair, he flung it away and threw himself on the ground. But Henry, following the sound of his enemy’s fall, lowered the rifle and pulled trigger. The Jefe yelled out in sharp pain as the bullet perforated his shoulder, rose to his feet, cursed, sprawled back on the ground, and lay there cursing.

Again in the cave, with the mestiza beside him at his knee, the Blind Brigand gave judgment.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u013-r0039", "tag": "p", "text": "“This man who is wounded and who talks much of the law of the tierra caliente, shall now learn Cordilleras law. By the test of the Snake and the Bird has he been proven guilty. For his life a ransom of ten thousand dollars gold shall be paid, or else shall he remain here, a hewer of wood and a carrier of water, for the remainder of the time God shall grant him to draw breath on earth. I have spoken, and I know that my voice is God’s voice, and I know that God will not grant him long to draw breath if the ransom be not forthcoming.”", "sha256": "e419ce5c858200b0f3aeec481c58dd7955d1df573a32e3fcf9bcdfcb0f0e26b9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1063]", "source_html": "
